info.title: deepsharp-serve
info.description: DeepSharp's own server: the notebook in your browser, on Verso's engine, with nothing else to install. Run deepsharp-serve beside a notebook; it listens on this computer alone and asks for the token it prints.

options.name: --port
options.description: the port to listen on, on this computer alone; one the system picks when none is named

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: say the address and open no browser, for a computer you reach from another
